status_rule: REJECTED when hard findings present; else STABLE when richardson strictly greater than ri_crit and both growths at most growth_stable_cap and findings empty and preferred_scheme equals scheme_primary; else UNSTABLE when richardson strictly less than ri_crit and both growths greater than growth_stable_cap; else TRANSITIONAL

finding_detail_format.rule: detail and entity_id are bare tokens only
finding_detail_format.encoder: floats quantized by round to 1e-12 then strconv.FormatFloat value g -1 64; integers via decimal digits
finding_detail_format.SOLVER_SPLIT: entity_id is preferred_scheme; detail is abs growth_primary minus growth_secondary only

encoding.floats: strconv.FormatFloat value g -1 64 after round to 1e-12

report_structure.findings_sort: sort by kind then entity_id then detail then assign finding_id indices
report_structure.finding_id_format: case_id::entity_id::NNNN four digit zero padded one based

policy_resolution: case top level then policy_overrides via growscan.ResolveCase; key ri_crit overrides when positive

numerics.resolution_damper: if steps_taken < min_steps then growth_analytic = 0.8 * base else base; store damped; apply before marching
numerics.timestep: speed is arithmetic mean of max-abs and RMS; dt = cfl_used*dx/speed; steps_taken = round(t_end/dt) min one
numerics.effective_dissipation: scale is scheme_ref_cfl / cfl_used; LF base 0.04 squared; upwind base 0.05 cubed
numerics.preferred_scheme: higher abs error versus stored growth_analytic; tie within 1e-12 then lex smaller
numerics.rejection_short_circuit: clear preferred; zero marched growths; zero growth_analytic

rejection_short_circuit.rule: after hard finding do not emit soft findings; preferred empty; marched growth zero; growth_analytic zero
